official_definition: Place X cards from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Poison Blade] or [Poison Blade: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Poison Blade]", "give [Poison Blade]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
